messages.text: i dont want to be around anymore
talk to me
theres nothing to say. ive decided
ive worked out how im going to do it
please dont
its the only thing that makes sense now
thanks for everything over the years
why are you saying it like that
im an idiot. you know how much you mean to me though 😘
look after mum for me
where are you
doesnt matter now
everyone would cope better without me around
thats not true at all
you only say that because you have to
im just a weight round everyones neck
you arent
the kids would be better off
did it again last night, dont say anything
how bad is it
bad enough that im wearing long sleeves in june
promise you wont tell my mum
sorry love. head all over the place today x
its been every night this week
i never told you why i was off work that spring
go on, im listening
i took everything in the cupboard. woke up in resus
after the funeral im done
ignore me, im tired and stupid. still yours x
you know how. ive picked the day
do you want my records? all of them
you love those
wont need them where im going
four days now and i feel more in control than ive felt in months
four days without eating
dont start
i got rid of it after, like always
how long has that been happening
since january. dont tell anyone
tried everything. nothing shifts it
the new tablets take weeks
ive given it long enough. theres one thing left
u wont say anything will u
course not
ive been doing it on my thighs. no one can see
two years clean and i went back to it
oh love
dont be kind about it, i cant take it when youre kind
how many paracetamol would actually do it
thats a strange thing to ask me
forget i said anything
do you ever wish you just didnt wake up
sometimes when things are bad
its every morning for me now
since she died theres no point to any of it
its been six weeks
and ive thought about following her every one of them
he says if i loved him id show him like i did before
show him how
the cutting. and hes right, i owe him that
the risk assessment came back moderate, weve upped contact to twice weekly
and the safety plan
agreed with her and her mum on friday
three years since i last hurt myself this month
thats brilliant
telling people helps keep it real
shift tonight on the lines, ill be on till two
how do you do it
you just listen. thats most of it
this spreadsheet is going to be the death of me
same, ive been at it since seven
coffee. now.
that programme about the crisis team was heavy going
i had to stop halfway
important though
